page.overview:
Who is Jenzo?

Jenzo was an Earth-based counselor and a colleague of Deanna Troi.

In 2377, as the was seven light years away from Jupiter Station, Troi suggested to Reginald Barclay that she could refer him to Jenzo instead of attempting to counsel Lewis Zimmerman long distance. Barclay, however, wanted "the best", and declined Troi's referral offer, preferring her advice to anyone else's. ()
